goal: Build a Spanish ESO/Bachillerato web app that names drawn organic molecules by IUPAC 2013 rules and, in v4, draws a molecule from a name built from tiles.

phases.title: Project scaffold
phases.summary: Creates the repo skeleton, HTML shell, CSS, single-file build and test tooling.

phases.title: Molecule model, validation, SMILES subset
phases.summary: Adds the molecule graph model, validation messages, canonical tree key and SMILES parser.

phases.title: Naming engine I: unbranched chains
phases.summary: Defines naming contracts and lexicon and names unbranched alkanes, alkenes and alkynes.

phases.title: Naming engine II: parent chain
phases.summary: Selects the parent chain and numbering (P1–P4, N1–N4) and names simple straight-chain substituents.

phases.title: Naming engine III: substituents
phases.summary: Names branched and unsaturated substituents recursively, with isopropil, PIN and substituted styles.

phases.title: Naming: ylidene groups and fixtures
phases.summary: Names doubly attached -iliden substituents at any depth, removes every unsupported path and grows the fixture set to 176 justified rows.

phases.title: Naming oracle
phases.summary: Adds an English renderer, an OPSIN round-trip oracle and graph-invariance tests; about 37,000 molecules checked with no naming bugs.

phases.title: Editor core
phases.summary: Builds the SVG drawing editor: carbons, bonds, erase, undo/redo, validation toasts, collision checks and a test API.

phases.title: Editor extras
phases.summary: Adds chain tool, move/marquee, pan/zoom, label toggle, live formula, autosave with recentring, shortcuts and chemical vs coordinate edit events.

phases.title: Explanation and results panel
phases.summary: Turns the naming trace into Spanish step-by-step explanations and adds the results panel with a stepper, alternatives and friendly errors.

phases.title: Redraw and examples
phases.summary: Adds the "Ordenar dibujo" canonical redraw with animation and undo, and an examples menu of 14 molecules.

phases.title: Polish and release
phases.summary: Adds the Ayuda dialog, accessibility and phone layout polish, e2e on the self-contained build and the English README.

phases.title: Visible carbon dots in skeletal mode
phases.summary: Marks every carbon vertex with a dot in skeletal mode so carbons can be counted at a glance.

phases.title: Single-bond drag grows a chain
phases.summary: Dragging with the single-bond tool grows a chain carbon by carbon, like MolView.

phases.title: 90-degree condensed-formula view toggle
phases.summary: Adds a toggle that draws the labelled-carbons view with 90-degree angles in textbook style, read-only while shown.

phases.title: Toggle to hide stepper highlights
phases.summary: Adds a stepper switch that hides or shows the canvas highlights and locant numbers.

phases.title: Editing in the 90° view
phases.summary: Makes every editing tool work while the 90° condensed drawing is shown.

phases.title: Author credit footer
phases.summary: Shows the page author and year in a footer and in the page metadata.

phases.title: Undo after Ordenar dibujo
phases.summary: Fixes Deshacer so it restores the hand-drawn layout after Ordenar dibujo.

phases.title: npm run deploy to Fastmail Files
phases.summary: Adds a documented npm run deploy that uploads the single-file build to Fastmail Files over HTTPS WebDAV.

phases.title: v2.1 Multi-element model
phases.summary: Extends atoms to C, O, N, F, Cl, Br, I with central valences and records the v2 plan in the design doc.

phases.title: v2.2 Multi-element SMILES and oracle
phases.summary: Teaches the SMILES reader/writer and the OPSIN oracle adapter about O, N and halogen atoms.

phases.title: v2.3 Element palette
phases.summary: Element palette places and changes C, O, N, F, Cl, Br and I; heteroatoms are drawn labelled with their hydrogens.

phases.title: v2.4 Ring infrastructure
phases.summary: Perceives and classifies rings, keys monocycles structurally, reads/writes SMILES ring closures and shows Spanish scope messages.

phases.title: v2.5 Simple cycloalkanes
phases.summary: Names bare saturated rings of 3 to 30 carbons (ciclopropano, ciclohexano…) and explains the ring closure.

phases.title: v2.6 Substituted and unsaturated rings
phases.summary: Names single carbocycles with side chains and ring double or triple bonds; the ring is always the parent.

phases.title: v2.7a Ring templates and inner double-bond lines
phases.summary: Editor ring tool places 3- to 8-carbon polygons, and ring double bonds draw their second line inside the ring.

phases.title: v2.7b Ordenar dibujo for rings
phases.summary: Ordenar dibujo lays out a named single ring as a regular polygon with side chains outside, locants and one undo step.

phases.title: v2.8 Benzene and hydrocarbon derivatives
phases.summary: Names benzene and single-substituent benzenes in either Kekulé form, adds a benzene ring template and oracle support.

phases.title: v2.9 Functional groups and seniority
phases.summary: Detects functional groups without overlaps and picks the principal one by seniority; heteroatom molecules are explained but not named yet.

phases.title: v2.10 Halogen derivatives
phases.summary: Names halogen derivatives with fluoro-, cloro-, bromo-, yodo- prefixes, multipliers and alphabetical order.

phases.title: v2.11 Alcohols
phases.summary: Names alcohols with -ol/-diol suffixes and hidroxi- prefixes, including cycloalkanols and fenol.

phases.title: v2.12 Aldehydes and ketones
phases.summary: Names aldehydes and ketones (etanal, propanona, oxo-/hidroxi- prefixes, cycloalkanones) and refuses out-of-scope carbonyls.

phases.title: v2.13 Carboxylic acids
phases.summary: Names open-chain carboxylic acids and diacids (ácido etanoico), with acid seniority over carbonyls and alcohols.

phases.title: v2.14 Ethers
phases.summary: Names ethers with alkoxy prefixes (metoxietano), choosing the parent side by explicit rules and highlighting both sides.

phases.title: v2.15 Esters
phases.summary: Names esters (etanoato de metilo), explaining the acid part and the O-bound group separately; Spanish and English orders differ.

phases.title: v2.16 Amines
phases.summary: Names primary, secondary and tertiary amines (-amina, N-locants, amino- prefix), including ring amines.

phases.title: v2.17 Amides
phases.summary: Names open-chain amides (-amida, N-locants, formamida/acetamida) and refuses ring amides, imides and amide prefixes.

phases.title: v2.18 Nitriles
phases.summary: Names open-chain nitriles (-nitrilo, acetonitrilo) and refuses ring nitriles, 3+ nitriles and the ciano- prefix for now.

phases.title: v2.19a ciano- prefix (split from I-39)
phases.summary: Names a nitrile beside an acid, ester or amide, or inside a branch, with the ciano- prefix, its carbon outside the parent.

phases.title: v2.19b Acyl prefixes formil-/acetil- (split from I-39)
phases.summary: Names a C=O carbon hung from its chain as a branch with formil-, acetil- and similar acyl prefixes.

phases.title: v2.19c Ester prefixes and diesters (split from I-39)
phases.summary: Names an ester beside an acid with alcoxicarbonil-/aciloxi- prefixes, and diesters.

phases.title: v2.19d Amide prefixes and pair matrix (split from I-39)
phases.summary: Names an amide beside an acid or ester with carbamoil-/acilamino- prefixes and completes the functional pair matrix.

phases.title: v2.20a Rings as substituents of a functional chain (split from I-40)
phases.summary: Names a chain carrying an OH, ketone or amine with a ring hung from it as ciclohexil-/fenil- (lifts sideChain refusals).

phases.title: v2.20b Acids and aldehydes with a ring, ring acyl prefixes (split from I-40)
phases.summary: Names -carboxílico/-carbaldehído on a ring (ácido benzoico, benzaldehído), those groups beside a ring, and benzoil-type prefixes.

phases.title: v2.20c Nitriles and amides with a ring (split from I-40)
phases.summary: Names -carbonitrilo/-carboxamida on rings (benzonitrilo, benzamida), N-fenil amides, and ciano-/carbamoil- on rings.

phases.title: v2.20d Ring esters (split from I-40)
phases.summary: Names esters with a ring on either side (benzoato de metilo, etanoato de fenilo, benzoato de fenilo); lactones refused.

phases.title: v2.21a 90° view for acyclic heteroatom molecules (split from I-41)
phases.summary: Right-angle (90°) condensed drawing now shows named acyclic molecules with O, N or halogen atoms; rings still fall back.

phases.title: v2.21b CHO/COOH optional abbreviations (split from I-41)
phases.summary: An optional toggle in the 90° view shortens aldehyde and acid groups to CHO/COOH labels without changing the molecule.

phases.title: v2.21c Ayuda, examples and docs wrap-up (split from I-41)
phases.summary: Help, grouped examples and docs now cover rings and functional groups; the v2 plan is complete.

phases.title: v3 Benzene parent with prefixes: engine, explanation, design §14
phases.summary: Benzenes with several hydrocarbon, halogen or alkoxy prefixes get Kekulé-neutral names and explanations.

phases.title: v3 Benzene parent with prefixes: oracle, e2e, layout checks
phases.summary: Oracle draws benzenes with 1–6 groups; end-to-end tests and Ordenar dibujo checks cover them.

phases.title: v3 One OH or amine on the ring, plus prefixes
phases.summary: Phenols and benzenamines with extra ring substituents are named, e.g. 4-metilfenol and N,4-dimetilbencen-1-amina.

phases.title: v3 One outside-carbon suffix on the ring, plus prefixes
phases.summary: Benzoic acids, benzaldehydes, benzonitriles and benzamides with extra ring substituents are named.

phases.title: v3 Several identical principal groups on the ring
phases.summary: Names benzenes with several identical principal groups, e.g. 3-etilbenceno-1,2-diol and benceno-1,4-diamina.

phases.title: v3 Substituted phenyl and phenoxy as a substituent
phases.summary: Substituted phenyl and phenoxy prefixes on functional chains, e.g. 1-(4-metilfenil)etan-1-ona.

phases.title: v3 Substituted benzoyl
phases.summary: Substituted benzoyl prefixes such as (4-metilbenzoil) are named wherever benzoil was; explanation follows the real bracket nesting.

phases.title: v3 Esters with substituted rings
phases.summary: Esters whose benzene rings carry prefixes are named, e.g. 4-metilbenzoato de 4-clorofenilo.

phases.title: v3 Wrap-up
phases.summary: Help text, examples, README, CLAUDE.md scope and oracle docs updated for polysubstituted benzenes.

phases.title: v4 R-1a Tiles, parser, assembler, tokenizer
phases.summary: Builds the tile catalogue, a lossless parser, the punctuation assembler and a tokenizer for open-chain hydrocarbon names.

phases.title: v4 R-1b Interpret, build, readName
phases.summary: Turns a fully located tile name into a molecule and a verdict (correct, alternative, other name, out of scope, invalid).

phases.title: v4 R-1c Left-out locants
phases.summary: Searches placements for names without locants and reports missing locants, ambiguity or an incomplete search.

phases.title: v4 R-2a Name-builder dialog
phases.summary: Adds the «¿Cómo se dibuja?» dialog with tile rows, the assembled name line, branch controls and keyboard support.

phases.title: v4 R-2b Dibujar and results
phases.summary: Draws the read molecule on the canvas as one undoable edit and shows the verdict in the results panel, with help and e2e.

phases.title: v4 R-3 Hydrocarbon diagnosis
phases.summary: Split into I-49a (diagnosis engine) and I-49b (diagnosis in the results panel), both done.

phases.title: v4 R-3a Diagnosis engine
phases.summary: Names the main mistake of a hydrocarbon name that the app names differently, in a pure diagnose module.

phases.title: v4 R-3b Diagnosis in the results panel
phases.summary: Shows the diagnosis in the verdict, highlights the student's chain beside the parent and opens the stepper at that rule's step.

phases.title: v4 R-4 Rings
phases.summary: Split into I-50a (ciclo rings), I-50b (benzene, phenyl, aromatic key), I-50c (retained templates, o/m/p, Ayuda) and I-50d (ring diagnosis), all done.

phases.title: v4 R-4a Cycloalkane and cycloalkene names from tiles
phases.summary: Extends tile names to ciclo rings as the parent or as a branch (ciclohexano, ciclohex-1-eno, ciclohexil).

phases.title: v4 R-4b Benzene and phenyl names from tiles
phases.summary: Extends tile names to benceno, fenil and substituted phenyl branches, treating both Kekule drawings as one molecule.

phases.title: v4 R-4c Retained aromatic names, o/m/p aliases and Ayuda
phases.summary: Adds tolueno, estireno, xileno and mesitileno tiles, the o/m/p forms and the Ayuda line for rings.

phases.title: v4 R-4d Ring diagnosis messages
phases.summary: Names the main mistake of a ring name, such as a ring that should be the parent, and shows it in the results panel.

phases.title: v4 R-5a Halogens and alcohols
phases.summary: Split into I-51a1 (halogens), I-51a2 (alcohols, phenols, the 1(6) locant control) and I-51a3 (phenol templates, alcohol diagnosis, Ayuda), all done.

phases.title: v4 R-5a1 Halogen prefixes
phases.summary: Adds fluoro, cloro, bromo and yodo tiles so halogen derivatives can be built and drawn from a name, with diagnosis.

phases.title: v4 R-5a2 Alcohols and phenols
phases.summary: Adds ol and hidroxi tiles, fenol, diol/tetrol morphology and the 1(6) closing-bond locant control.

phases.title: v4 R-5a3 Phenol templates, alcohol diagnosis, Ayuda
phases.summary: Split into I-51a3a (retained phenol templates, Ayuda line) and I-51a3b (alcohol diagnosis messages), both done.

phases.title: v4 R-5a3a Retained phenol templates and Ayuda line
phases.summary: Reads cresol, catecol, pirocatecol, resorcinol and hidroquinona as alternatives and updates the Ayuda line for alcohols.

phases.title: v4 R-5a3b Alcohol diagnosis messages
phases.summary: Names the student's main mistake in alcohol names: OH numbering, hidroxi for the principal OH, the OH-decided parent, suffix locants, bencenol.

phases.title: v4 R-5b Ethers
phases.summary: Extends tile names to ethers; split into I-51b1 (alkoxy prefixes, anisol) and I-51b2 (class names, ether diagnosis), both done.

phases.title: v4 R-5b1 Alkoxy and phenoxy prefixes, anisol
phases.summary: Reads alkoxy and phenoxy prefixes and the anisol template in tile names, with left-out locants searched.

phases.title: v4 R-5b2 Ether class names and ether diagnosis
phases.summary: Reads ether class names such as etil metil éter from tiles and names the main mistake of an ether name.

phases.title: v4 R-5c Aldehydes and ketones
phases.summary: Extends tile names to aldehydes and ketones; split into I-51c1 (suffixes, oxo, formil), I-51c2 (acyl prefixes), I-51c3 (templates, diagnosis).

phases.title: v4 R-5c1 Carbonyl suffixes al/ona/carbaldehído, benzaldehído, oxo and formil prefixes
phases.summary: Reads aldehyde and ketone suffixes, benzaldehído and the oxo and formil prefixes in tile names, with left-out locants searched.

phases.title: v4 R-5c2 Acyl prefixes
phases.summary: Reads acyl prefixes such as acetil, propanoil, benzoil and ciclohexanocarbonil in tile names, with left-out locants searched.

phases.title: v4 R-5c3 Carbonyl templates, aldehyde and ketone diagnosis, Ayuda line
phases.summary: Reads retained carbonyl names and names carbonyl mistakes; split into I-51c3a (templates, Ayuda line) and I-51c3b (diagnosis).

phases.title: v4 R-5c3a Retained carbonyl templates and the Ayuda carbonyl line
phases.summary: Reads retained carbonyl names such as acetona, acetofenona and the ftalaldehídos in tile names, with the Ayuda line for carbonyls.

phases.title: v4 R-5c3b Aldehyde and ketone diagnosis messages
phases.summary: Names carbonyl mistakes; split into I-51c3b1 (principal-group messages) and I-51c3b2 (acyl-word and template-phenyl messages).

phases.title: v4 R-5c3b1 Aldehyde and ketone principal-group diagnosis messages
phases.summary: Names a carbonyl name's principal-group mistakes: wrong suffix, C=O numbering, chain or ring parent, needless suffix locants.

phases.title: v4 R-5c3b2 Acyl-word and acetaldehído-phenyl diagnosis messages
phases.summary: Names mistakes in acyl prefix words (etanoil, (1-oxoetil), acyl chain, carbonil locant) and in a ring branch numbered otherwise.

phases.title: v4 R-5d Acids
phases.summary: Extends tile names to carboxylic acids; split into I-51d1 (suffixes, ácido, carboxi), I-51d2 (templates, Ayuda) and I-51d3 (diagnosis), all done.

phases.title: v4 R-5d1 ácido class word, oico/carboxílico suffixes, ácido benzoico, carboxi prefix
phases.summary: Reads acid names built from tiles: the ácido class word, oico and carboxílico suffixes, ácido benzoico and the carboxi prefix.

phases.title: v4 R-5d2 Retained acid templates and Ayuda acid line
phases.summary: Reads traditional acid names such as ácido acético, ácido oxálico and the ftálico family, and adds the Ayuda acid line.

phases.title: v4 R-5d3 Acid diagnosis messages
phases.summary: Names the mistakes in an acid name built from tiles, each with its step in the explanation.

phases.title: v4 R-6a Esters
phases.summary: Extends tile names to esters; split into I-52a1 (suffixes, O-bound side), I-52a2 (templates, ester prefixes, Ayuda) and I-52a3 (diagnosis).

phases.title: v4 R-6a1 Ester suffixes oato/carboxilato, benzoato and the O-bound side
phases.summary: Reads ester names built from tiles: oato, carboxilato and benzoato with the automatic de and y and the O-bound side multipliers.

phases.title: v4 R-6a2 Retained ester names, ester prefixes and Ayuda ester line
phases.summary: Reads formiato and acetato, the aciloxi and alcoxicarbonil ester prefixes, and adds the Ayuda ester line.

phases.title: v4 R-6a3 Ester diagnosis messages
phases.summary: Names the mistakes in an ester name built from tiles, each with its step in the explanation.

phases.title: v4 R-6b Nitriles
phases.summary: Extends tile names to nitriles, carbonitriles, ciano prefixes and traditional nitrile names.

phases.title: v4 R-6c Amines
phases.summary: Extends tile names to amines with N locants, amino prefixes, anilina templates and class names.

phases.title: v4 R-6d Amides
phases.summary: Extends tile names to amides, carboxamides, carbamoil and acylamino prefixes and traditional amide names.

phases.title: v4 R-7 Wrap-up
phases.summary: Runs the closed loop over every generator and finishes help, README, CLAUDE.md and the wording list for teacher review.

phases.title: o/m/p letters for two different prefixes on benceno, both directions
phases.summary: Names and reads benzenes with two different groups by orto/meta/para letters, such as m-cloroetilbenceno (user decision 2026-10-15).
